summary: Revised the Fabric.js ATS resume canvas to fully transform the resume from a Marketing Manager profile to an Operations Analyst profile. Updated the header role title, rewrote the Summary section text, replaced all marketing-focused Experience roles and responsibilities with Operations Analyst relevant content. Completely replaced the Skills section with Operations Analyst skills and removed all marketing-specific skills. Updated the Projects section to reflect a realistic Operations Analyst project. Replaced marketing-specific Certifications with relevant Operations Analyst certifications and removed marketing credentials. Updated Education content to align with Operations Analyst qualifications. Corrected Certifications section to fix visible text overlaps, improved line heights, textbox heights, wrapping, and added vertical spacing to ensure clear readable separation, also ensuring sufficient spacing before the Languages section. Fixed left-sidebar text wrapping and rebalanced sidebar vertical spacing using existing empty space for balance and no compression overlaps. Verified no overlapping text, clipping, out-of-bounds rendering, and consistent positive spacing throughout all text objects. Preserved dark header, two-column layout, sidebar treatment, and typography hierarchy, adjusting only necessary text boxes and section positions to safely fit the corrected content. Preserved candidate name and contact information structure as-is. Confirmed full role-target integrity across all sections with consistent Operations Analyst identity and no residual marketing content.
